name: Pinnacle Factotum

abilities.name: Heavy Attack
abilities.description: The heavy attack has some additional shock charges that are thrown around the arena when it lands. Anyone not blocking those charges will be CC'd

abilities.name: Cone Blast
abilities.description: A charge/release a conical blast. As a dps or healer, block, step out, or roll dodge to avoid the main damage of this attack. Any character caught in the cone without a block will be tossed back.

abilities.name: Lightning AOE
abilities.description: A teleport strike to a player that lays a static AOE at the drop site.

abilities.name: Homing AoE
abilities.description: AoEs appear under every player in the party, and go off after a few seconds. Avoid overlapping together to reduce the damage applied, which is otherwise very high if overlap occurs.

abilities.name: Resource Drain
abilities.description: A channeled attack that will drain resources from all players until interrupted. If the attack completes, it hits for a final burst of damage.

abilities.name: Simulacra [Starts after 80% HP]
abilities.description: The boss will CC whatever currently has aggro and split into 4 copies around the target. The target will have a small friendly AOE under their feet, and leaving it will instantly kill that character. Each simulacrum will wake up and start a palm strike that fires in a cone pattern. The character locked in the middle needs to turn and block the animating simulacrum before it goes off to mitigate the damage to the party.

notes: The Pinnacle Factotum model predates the Series 7 Factotum model, which is why they use the Refabricated Style and have more Dwemer-inspired humanoid features.
related_quests: Forging the Future: Stem the tide of fabricants before they overwhelm Tel Fyr.
summary: The Pinnacle Factotum is a Factotum encountered in the Halls of Fabrication after Hunter-Killer Positrox and Hunter-Killer Negatrix are defeated, serving as the second boss of the trial.
